objective: Comprehensive CMP40HX / TU106 reverse engineering: VBIOS 1 MiB, MMIO/BAR0, fuse/OTP, GSP-RM, Falcon firmware, GPU topology, PCIe, memory subsystem, unknown fields/bits/registers; evidence-backed, distinguishing readably-decoded data from genuinely-decoded semantics.
scope: Offline read-only evidence audit of the supplied cmp40hx_research_v15_final.tar.gz archive and public NVIDIA/envytools sources. No new hardware access, no MMIO/OTP/PCIe writes, no ROM flash/reload, no driver reload/reboot, no clock/voltage changes, no exploit/bypass, no key extraction.
completion_rule: Full objective remains unproven until every subsystem requirement is supported by authoritative evidence. Test/PASS counts, file presence, manifests, prose reports, and live worker state never establish whole-GPU completion.

workstreams.title: GSP-RM callback: ELF mapping, caller/callback, dataflow

requirements.text: Independent ELF VA/file mapping
requirements.detail: VA = file_offset + 0x3FFFFC0 (inner ELF offset 0x40), verified on 6 mappings (loop, entry, JAL, callback, descriptor table, caller). Not a global mapping for NOBITS/every section.
requirements.gaps: Global mapping for all sections not established.

requirements.text: All callback predecessors and last definitions of a0/a1/a2
requirements.detail: Taken-branch path decoded: 0x4f57644/48 AUIPC/JALR -> helper 0x4f075ec; 0x4f5764c mv a1,a0; 0x4f57650 bnez a0 -> 0x4f575d4; callback at 0x4f575e0 via jalr a5 where a5=ld [s3+0x30], a2=lhu [s0-0x88], a0=s3. a1 retains helper return on this path.
requirements.gaps: Full-function predecessors not exhaustively verified; callback target *(s3+0x30) unknown; helper alias/mutation of temp struct unknown; a1 on all paths unknown; parent caller of 0x04F06C18 not found.

requirements.text: Raw bytes and branch/call targets
evidence: PHASE16/gsp_callback_verified.txt/.json (84 instruction rows compared to original bytes, 0 mismatches)
requirements.detail: Raw bytes preserved: 93050500 (mv a1,a0), e31205f8 (bnez a0), c8dff06f (JAL x0 -0x374 -> 0x4F575BC), 6ff0dfc8 (jump to loop).
requirements.gaps: Only the observed instruction window, not the whole function.

requirements.text: Callback identity or explicit unresolved evidence
requirements.detail: Callback dispatched through indirect pointer *(s3+0x30); target not resolved. Explicitly tracked as unresolved, not inferred.
requirements.gaps: Callback identity entirely missing; dataflow bugs in follow-up (lhu size, store no rd, S-immediate) block acceptance.

requirements.text: Parse complete header and all payload spans
requirements.detail: NVUCODES header ver=1 count=496@0x0c fp=0x8D1990AB6B98AE2B; 496 x 24-byte records; 38 payloads; all spans non-overlapping; coverage sum 8,824,912 + header/table 11,928 + padding 792 = file size 8,837,632; last payload ends exactly at EOF. Independent marker scan: 38 hits/38 confirmed/0 extra/0 missing.

requirements.text: Validate candidate lengths, padding, overlaps, coverage
requirements.detail: 496 raw records and 38 payload hashes checked against binary; no overlap/hash mismatch.
